propositions: When enforce_plan_material_pins is enabled, pin drift, missing pinned targets, or malformed pin records invalidate the attestation and block claim-gate and progressive refresh
Configuration read failures for the optional enforce_plan_material_pins key return false and emit a structured warning without raising, following fail-open rollout semantics
The sidecar stores reviewed_related_material as an ordered list of {role, canonical_id, material_fingerprint} items in plan_review_result_v2, and pre-feature readers ignore the additive field
Re-sign with enforcement enabled refuses to proceed if review-time pin records show drift or missing targets, unless no certified attestation exists and own material remains current

Drift-refresh and claim-gate consumers receive health diagnostics alongside validity verdicts through named-key consumption, with health aggregating target status by fixed severity and enforcement enabling or disabling its invalidation

Legacy unpinned attestations and pre-feature sidecars remain valid across configuration toggles, with malformed pins generating immediate failure and unreadable targets producing stale-pin-missing advisories
